newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian student hands back mistaken millions.
newsitem.headline: Italian student hands back mistaken millions.

text.p: A young Italian found himself rich beyond his dreams when an error added 40,000,000,000 lire ($26 million) to his post office savings account.

Francesco Caccavella, a 23-year-old university student from Sulmona in eastern Italy, did the honest thing and pointed out the error. The post office was investigating the mistake, the ANSA news agency reported on Tuesday.
